_about: The rung-2 opus designer's own checks.json plus the reviewer's rows: feeds on the DRV8874 VM pin and declared decoupling rows for the bypass caps the datasheet names, at 2.0 mm (R2-T5). Scores: see FINDINGS R2.

VIN.source: J4 via Q1 (AO4407A reverse-polarity FET), 6-17 V

connectors.5V_HDR.source: 5V through D2 B5819W to J3 pin 1

calcs.note: IPC-2221 external, 1 oz, 20 degC rise: VIN and Power5V class 1.4 mm
Motor class 0.8 mm
Vref 0.8 V, R4 top / R5 bottom
L1 2.2 uH at VIN max 17 V, 3 A load
2 x 22 uF 25 V 0805 derated to 22 uF effective at 5 V; ESR 3 mOhm for the pair
worst case D = 0.5 (VIN 10 V); carried by C1, C2 (GRM21BR61H106KE43L, 10 uF 50 V X5R)
C17 BXJ35V220M8*10 rating 600 mA at 100 kHz, 160 mOhm; the 1.5 MHz ripple is taken by the ceramics (2 x 10 uF, a few mOhm), the bulk sees motor-frequency current
EN divider R1/R2, Ip 1.15 uA
Ip + Ih = 4.55 uA
TPS54620 eq 34
eq 36; C8 = 15 nF
AMS1117 at the 500 mA budget
theta_JA 90 K/W for SOT-223 on a small pad (AMS1117 datasheet), 40 degC ambient
DRV8874 A_IPROPI 455 uA/A, R_IPROPI = R14
current regulation holds V_IPROPI at V_VREF, so the ADC pin never exceeds v_vref
AO4407A R_DS(on) 14 mOhm max at VGS -10 V (VIN >= 10 V)
R_DS(on) 20 mOhm at VGS -6 V (VIN 6 V)
a series SS54 Schottky at 0.55 V would dissipate this; the FET is chosen instead
0.6/0.3 mm vias in the 2.46 x 3.55 mm pad, 2 x 3 grid at 1.2 x 1.1 mm

accepted_warns.reason: VIN_RAW is probed on the J4 pin 1 screw (BRINGUP step 3)
5V_HDR is probed on J3 pin 1 (BRINGUP step 7)

signals._about: SIG-1: per-net driver edge, with the source of the number; `pcb signals` computes knee (0.5/t_rise) and bucket. Rails are judged by irdrop/currents, not knee. Assumptions are marked; replace them with measured edges when a scope is on the board.

SW.source: assumption: the TPS54620 datasheet gives no SW edge rate (min on-time 94 ns is the nearest number); monolithic 6 A sync bucks measure 2-5 ns on SW, 3 ns taken
SW.note: the aggressor the stackup policy is built around; In1 is its return

buck.BUCK_BOOT.driver: U1.13 BOOT, rides on SW through C5 100 nF
buck.BUCK_BOOT.source: same edge as SW (the bootstrap cap ties the node to SW)

PWM.driver: MCU GPIO on J3 -> U2.1 EN/IN1
PWM.source: assumption: MCU GPIO behind the control header, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns; no series R on the board or the cable
PWM.note: U2.1 has only the internal 100 k pull-down; a 100 R + 100 pF RC at the header would make it 22 ns (bucket 2)

DIR.driver: MCU GPIO on J3 -> U2.2 PH/IN2
DIR.source: assumption: MCU GPIO behind the control header, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns; no series R on the board or the cable
DIR.note: toggles rarely; the bucket follows the edge, not the rate

nSLEEP.driver: MCU GPIO on J3 -> U2.3 nSLEEP
nSLEEP.source: assumption: MCU GPIO behind the control header, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns; no series R on the board or the cable
nSLEEP.note: toggles rarely; the bucket follows the edge, not the rate

connectors.ENC_A_IN.source: assumption: push-pull 3.3 V CMOS encoder output, 10 ns (the brief names no encoder); an open-collector hall encoder would be 100 ns-1 us (bucket 1-2)

ENC_A.source: R10 1k into the header-side load (~20 pF ribbon + MCU input): 2.2 RC = 44 ns, root-sum-square with the 10 ns source edge

MOTOR_A.source: DRV8874 datasheet tRISE/tFALL 150 ns (OUTx 10-90 %, VM 24 V)
MOTOR_A.note: 2 A edges: the magnetic aggressor for the sense nets (victim spacing), not a fast one

MOTOR_B.source: DRV8874 datasheet tRISE/tFALL 150 ns (OUTx 10-90 %, VM 24 V)

nFAULT.source: assumption: no nFAULT edge spec in the DRV8874 datasheet; open-drain pull-down into ~20 pF taken as 20 ns; the rise is R16 x ~20 pF ~ 0.4 us

driver.FAULT_LED_A.driver: nFAULT through the fault LED D3 (cathode on nFAULT); R18 1k from 3V3
driver.FAULT_LED_A.source: follows nFAULT's fall through the LED (series part)

IPROPI.driver: U2.6 IPROPI current mirror into R14 2.74k
IPROPI.source: the mirror follows the bridge current, which steps at the OUTx edge (tRISE 150 ns); weak aggressor (IIPROPI <= 3 mA)
IPROPI.note: analog, 2.74k source impedance, ~1.2 V/A; noise here is current-regulation error

ISENSE.note: ADC line to the header; high impedance

buck.BUCK_FB.driver: 5V through the feedback divider R4 53.6k / R5 10k (DC)
buck.BUCK_FB.note: error-amplifier input, ~8 k source impedance; noise here is duty-cycle noise

buck.BUCK_COMP.source: compensation node, bandwidth about the crossover (tens of kHz)

buck.BUCK_RT.note: high-impedance node; pickup here is frequency jitter

buck.BUCK_SS.driver: U1.9 SS into C4 10 nF (slow ramp)
buck.BUCK_SS.note: mild victim: matters at start-up only

driver.DRV_CPH.driver: U2.13 CPH charge-pump switch into C13 22 nF
driver.DRV_CPH.source: no edge spec; slew bound by I/C: tens of mA into 22 nF over ~5 V is >= 2 us; fVCP 400 kHz (datasheet)

driver.DRV_CPL.driver: U2.14 CPL charge-pump switch into C13 22 nF

driver.DRV_VCP.driver: U2.12 VCP charge-pump output into C12 100 nF (VM + ~5 V)

buck.BUCK_EN.driver: VIN through R1 102k / R2 30.1k (UVLO divider, DC)
buck.BUCK_EN.note: mild victim: 23 k node sets the UVLO threshold
